products.name: Thooyamalli Rice – Traditional Rice
products.short_description:
1. A traditional rice variety valued for generations
  2. Naturally white and a good source of energy
  3. A strong and resilient crop that needs fewer pesticides
  4. Named after jasmine for its appearance and mild aroma
  5. Ideal for biriyani and pairs well with sambar, rasam, and curries
  6. Supports overall body strength and wellness
products.description:
Learn why Thooyamalli Rice is a better choice

  • The name comes from “Thooya” meaning pure and “Malli” meaning jasmine, inspired by its clean look and gentle fragrance
  • A lesser-known traditional rice variety with strong nutritional value
  • Widely enjoyed in earlier times, including by royal households
  • Can be used as a healthier alternative to regular white rice
  • Suitable for many dishes like biriyani, sambar rice, rasam rice, and variety rice
  • Can be dried and ground into flour for dishes like kozhukattai, pongal, idli, and dosa
  • Light on the stomach and fits well into daily meals

How to cook Thooyamali Rice: 

  1. Wash 1 cup of Thooyamalli rice 2 to 3 times
  2. Soak the rice for 20 to 30 minutes
  3. (For the cooker method, add soaked rice and allow 3 whistles)
  4. Boil 4 cups of water in a pot (add salt if needed)
  5. Add the soaked rice to boiling water
  6. Cook on medium flame until rice becomes soft
  7. Drain the excess water
  8. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving

products.name: Groundnut Oil (Cold Pressed)
products.short_description:
Cold-pressed groundnut oil is made using the traditional wooden chekku method (Marachekku in Tamil).

This method helps retain the oil’s original nutrients and natural flavor.

Also known as ‘Marachekku’ kadalai ennai.

It has a high smoking point, making it ideal for deep frying and regular cooking.
products.description:
Why Cold Pressed Oil? 

  • No Harmful Compounds: When regular oils are heated, their molecular structure breaks down, producing harmful free radicals that can increase the risk of cancer.
  • Better for Heart & Blood: Heated oils can contribute to cardiovascular problems and make it harder for blood to carry oxygen efficiently.
  • Nutrient Retention: Cold-pressed oils are extracted without heat, so their natural nutrients, vitamins, and healthy fats remain intact.
  • Pure & Natural Taste: Since they are not exposed to high temperatures or chemicals, cold-pressed oils have a rich, authentic flavor.
  • Longer Shelf Life: Their unaltered structure and natural antioxidants help them stay fresh for a longer time.
  • Healthier Choice: Overall, cold-pressed oils support better health while enhancing the taste and quality of your food.

Usage 

  • Commonly used for frying snacks, sautéing vegetables, and everyday cooking because of its high smoking point.
  • Adds a rich, earthy taste to South Indian recipes, sweets, and pickles.
  • It can be used in salad dressings, chutneys, or drizzled over cooked food for extra flavor and nutrition.
  • Consumed as part of a healthy diet to support heart health, control cholesterol, and improve overall wellness.

Recipes to do with Groundnut Oil – (Cold Pressed)

  • Vegetable Stir Fry – Enhances veggies with a light, nutty flavor and perfect sauté.
  • Tempering for Dals & Curries – Brings out authentic aroma and depth to traditional dishes.
  • Sambar – Adds richness and balance to the classic South Indian favorite.
  • Rasam – Infuses a warm, aromatic touch for a perfect finishing drizzle.
  • Chapati / Paratha Cooking – Gives soft, flavorful rotis with a golden finish.
  • Idli Podi Oil Mix – Blends beautifully with podi for a delicious, aromatic dip.
  • Medu Vadai – Ensures crispy, golden vadas with a soft inside.
  • Masala Vadai – Enhances flavor and gives a perfect crunchy texture.

products.name: Kadalai Mittai 200 Gms
products.short_description:
Dry Groundnuts dipped and rolled through jaggery & sugar syrup(stirred with cardamon, ginger), will take your taste buds to another planet for some time on every crunchy munch!!!

Every bite of it shows the originality & uniqueness by relishing yourself in the taste, this not just another Kadalai Mittai available in supermarkets! Feel the groundnut on every biteeee!!!

Product weight: 200gms
products.description:
Kadalai Mittai

Kadalai mittai is made all over the places and some brands even manufacture in factory and sell in super markets as kovilpatti kadalai mittai. But none of them can match the taste and quality of original kovilpatti kadalai mittai. It become famous through word of mouth just because of its unique taste. The recipe was originally prepared by Ponnambala Nadar around 1940. The current young experts and  their fathers learnt the trick from him and this is being now passed on to generations. Ponnambala Nadar had a small petti shop in market area. He decided to make kadalai mittai from the excess groundnut from his store. Since he is quality conscious, it become a hit slowly and over the years the kovilpatti kadalai mittai fame spread across the globe.

Why kadalai Mittai is different?

Kovilpatti kadalai mittai is made from jaggery and with all natural ingredients. Regular kadai mittai is made of white sugar. It made with 3 types of jaggery. All of them are melt and mixed at appropriate proportion to make the jaggery syrup.
